english.title: Pilot of aircraft other than balloon fail to ensure passengers seated and properly secured
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the pilot in command of an aircraft, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AIRCRAFT..), which was not a balloon, failed to ensure that each passenger on board occupied a seat or berth and had their safety belt or restraint device properly secured

(A)_[prior to and during taxiing, take-off and landing]_
(B)_[when deemed necessary in the interest of safety]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 71 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
